title: henckelia fasciculiflora

It is a herbaceous perennial native to the Western Ghats of India, known for its unique striped leaves and vibrant flowers. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Henckelia fasciculiflora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties.
